{% load i18n money %}# {{ site.name }}

> {{ site.tagline }} Online music theory courses taught by {{ site.instructor }}, an independent musician and music educator based in {{ site.location }}.

{{ site.name }} sells and delivers {% if course %}{{ course.title }}{% else %}music theory courses{% endif %} directly to students. The primary market is Bangladesh; international students and international card payments are supported. Prices are in Bangladeshi Taka (BDT).

{% if course %}
## {{ course.title }}{% if course.subtitle %} · {{ course.subtitle }}{% endif %}

- **URL**: {{ base_url }}{{ course.get_absolute_url }}
- **Price**: {{ course.price|taka }} BDT, one-time payment, lifetime access
- **Level**: {{ course.level }}
- **Modules**: {{ course.module_count }}{% if course.total_runtime %}
- **Total video**: {{ course.total_runtime }}{% endif %}{% if course.free_module %}
- **Free preview**: Module {{ course.free_module.number_plain }} ({{ course.free_module.title }}) is free with any registered account{% endif %}
- **Languages**: Bangla and English; every page, lesson and quiz exists in both
- **Each module contains**: a video lesson, written notes in Markdown, MP3 audio examples, SVG notation diagrams, downloadable worksheets and a multiple-choice quiz
- **Unlocking**: a module unlocks once the previous module's quiz is answered with 100% accuracy; students may retry a question until they choose the correct answer

## Payment methods

bKash, Nagad, Visa and Mastercard issued in Bangladesh, and international cards charged in BDT. Payment is handled by the payment provider; card details are never stored by {{ site.name }}. Enrolment is automatic once payment is confirmed.

## Refunds

Within 7 days of purchase, if fewer than two modules have been completed. See {{ base_url }}{% url 'pages:legal' 'refunds' %}.

## Languages

Every public page exists in Bangla, the primary language, and in English. The links below are the English pages; the Bangla page is the same address without the /en/ prefix (for example {{ base_url }}{% language 'bn' %}{% url 'courses:list' %}{% endlanguage %}).

## Contact

Email: {{ site.email }} — replies within two working days.

## Not available to crawlers

Lesson pages, videos, audio, worksheets, quizzes, student dashboards and order records require a signed-in account and are excluded in robots.txt. Please do not represent their contents.
